title: Great Expectations

vibeProfile.oneLine: A poor boy's mysterious fortune, and the true cost of becoming a gentleman.

summary: A poor village boy named Pip is lifted into wealth and gentility by a mysterious benefactor, and learns too late what his 'great expectations' have cost him and where the money truly came from. Dickens's late masterpiece is a searching study of class, snobbery and self-deception, anchored by unforgettable figures like the frozen Miss Havisham and the convict Magwitch. Tighter and more haunting than his early comedies, it is many readers' favourite of all his books.
whyReadIt: Dickens at his most haunting and mature, a boy remade by mysterious wealth. Miss Havisham never leaves you.

funFacts.text: Dickens rewrote the ending after a friend urged him to make it less bleak.
